title: DECODE: code, configurations and evidence
description:
Code, frozen configurations and evidence for the paper DECODE: Decomposable Environments for COntrolled Sequential-Decision Evaluation (arXiv preprint, 2026). The release contains the world generator and the configurations and seeds of the five released members, the construction checks, the references and probes, the code of every graded solver (with the trained CE-Seq weights and the fitted GBM-cash model), the experiment drivers, the per-loan evidence behind every closed-loop interval on Base, and the code of the data figures. The worlds are regenerated from the recorded seeds.

Code is licensed under MIT; configurations, manifests, evidence, model weights and the rule policy under CC BY 4.0 (files LICENSE and LICENSE-DATA). No Fannie Mae loan-level data are included; the drawn cohort is recorded by a fingerprint.
